# netbox_virtual_circuit_terminations (Data Source)

Lists virtual_circuit_termination objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_circuit_terminations" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, interface_id, interface_id__n, role, role__empty, role__ic, role__ie, role__iew, role__iregex, role__isw, role__n, role__nic, role__nie, role__niew, role__nisw, role__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n, virtual_circuit_id, virtual_circuit_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `virtual_circuit_terminations` (Attributes List) The matching virtual_circuit_terminations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_circuit_terminations))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--virtual_circuit_terminations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_circuit_terminations`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `device_interface_id` (Number) Id of the device interface the virtual circuit terminates on.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `role` (String) Role of this termination in the virtual circuit. Leaving it unset keeps the current value. One of: peer, hub, spoke.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
- `virtual_circuit_id` (Number) Id of the terminated virtual circuit.
